# Assessment Overview

Supplementary assessment documents available for this report:

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level application architecture and detailed component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category with compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - MVC/API surface, communication patterns, and service contract summary.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity relationships, persistence patterns, and sensitivity notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime/build settings, and framework/runtime version inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core academic administration workflows, business rules, and workflow sequence documentation.
